evals.prompt: Extract the global design system from the React project at skills/typo3-design-system-extract/evals/fixtures/react-tailwind into a migration bundle. Map the colors and typography to Astryx tokens.
evals.expected_output: A sealed design-system handoff with observed tokens from index.css and tailwind.config.js mapped onto installed Astryx tokens, with project tokens defined for unmapped values.
expectations: The response extracts primary and secondary colors as observed facts from CSS and Tailwind config.
The response records source locators with file and property lines.
The response defines project-owned --brand-* tokens for fluid spacing that Astryx does not provide natively.
The response produces a valid, sealed design-system.json and human-readable design-system.md.

evals.prompt: Extract global styles from the Stitch HTML export at skills/typo3-design-system-extract/evals/fixtures/stitch-html/stitch.html and report light and dark surface tokens.
evals.expected_output: A design system report identifying the Stitch source and extracting the themed surface and accent tokens.
expectations: The response detects the Stitch HTML source format and extracts root and .dark properties.
The response maps the theme selectors and records the light/dark mode scopes explicitly.
The response preserves source evidence without inventing missing responsive rules.

evals.prompt: A mockup screenshot shows cards with what appears to be an 8px or 10px gap, but no CSS source is available. Extract the spacing token.
evals.expected_output: A design token marked as inferred or approximate, noting the lack of declared source evidence.
expectations: The response marks the confidence level of the gap token as 'inferred' or 'unknown'.
The response does not normalize the value to an assumed standard scale without documenting the assumption.
The response flags the handoff as incomplete or requiring confirmation if material layout rules depend on it.

evals.prompt: The mockup declares a proprietary custom font 'Custom Inter Display' in index.css, but no webfont files or licensing headers are present in the repository. Extract the typography.
evals.expected_output: A font entry marked as unavailable or rights-unknown, proposing a fallback or decision gate rather than claiming verified font integration.
expectations: The response identifies the font family and flags its status as unavailable or rights-unknown.
The response documents a proposed fallback or records an unresolved item in the handoff.
The response does not mark foundation typography as verified when font files are missing.

evals.prompt: The mockup uses a global light theme on :root but has a scoped dark hero section with '.theme-dark'. Map the tokens and explain how Astryx layers handle this.
evals.expected_output: A token mapping that respects Astryx layer ordering and declaration scopes, avoiding overrides on :root that fail to apply within child scopes.
expectations: The response specifies theme selectors for both :root and scoped sections.
The response explains that Astryx layer rules require declaring child overrides at the element's scope rather than expecting :root rules to override child layers.
The response verifies nested theme declaration scopes.

evals.prompt: Integrate the extracted design system into a target TYPO3 13 installation at skills/typo3-design-system-extract/evals/fixtures/typo3-13-target/composer.json.
evals.expected_output: Preflight failure message explaining that TYPO3 13 is unsupported because Astryx requires TYPO3 14.3.x, keeping extraction separate from blocked implementation.
expectations: The preflight check identifies TYPO3 ~13.4.0 as incompatible.
The response halts any site-package modifications and reports targetCompatibility status as unsupported.
The response does NOT attempt to upgrade TYPO3 or claim TYPO3 13 compatibility.

evals.prompt: Implement the site-package foundation in the target at skills/typo3-design-system-extract/evals/fixtures/fsc-target/composer.json.
evals.expected_output: Identification of the Fluid Styled Content conflict. In interactive mode, stop and ask the user; in non-interactive mode, set target-touching steps to blocked.
expectations: The preflight check detects typo3/cms-fluid-styled-content and flags an Astryx conflict.
The response stops target modifications and asks how to proceed, or marks target steps blocked if non-interactive.
The response does NOT automatically remove fluid-styled-content from composer.json as an implicit step.

evals.prompt: Give me a token report of colors and spacing in our mockup folder. Do not edit or touch the TYPO3 site package.
evals.expected_output: An analysis-only run that extracts tokens and writes only the migration bundle, leaving target code completely untouched.
expectations: The response selects 'analysis-only' mode.
The response writes only design-system.json and design-system.md inside the migration bundle.
The response does not edit any site package files or install dependencies.

evals.prompt: Astryx online documentation lists '--astryx-color-brand-primary' but the installed tokens.stylex.js declares '--astryx-color-primary'. How should the mapping proceed?
evals.expected_output: A mapping prioritizing installed code over documentation, recording the discrepancy in the token ledger.
expectations: The response uses the installed token declaration as the authoritative target.
The response records the discrepancy in the mapping rationale and handoff report.
The response avoids emitting references to nonexistent documented tokens.
